name: Warm Memories
source:
Warm Memories is a furry short story in the form of a visual novel. It is told from your perspective, showcasing a multitude of events that happened once you met a stranger on the beach.

[from [url=https://ruiontheweb.itch.io/warm-memories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《温暖的回忆》是一部视觉小说形式的毛茸茸的短篇故事。它从你的角度讲述，展示了你在海滩上遇到陌生人时发生的大量事件。

[来自[url=https://ruiontheweb.itch.io/warm-memories]itch.io[/url]]
